Hi team,

Quick note from the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways: keep leaning on the calm, step-by-step review when a pet booking needs extra care. It helps us stay steady for travelers and keeps the handoff smooth for the cabin and ground teams. If a case feels a little messy, slow it down, check the paperwork, and share the status clearly with the next person in line.

For Cloudrest, <<FACT F040>> please make sure the customer notes stay clear and the pet paperwork matches the live itinerary. For Windmere, <<FACT F035>> and that means we should keep every step coordinated before boarding starts. When a traveler asks about onboard handling, <<FACT F053>> so the answer stays consistent across the team. If Rosie, Ines Hassan, or Isaac Davis comes up in a case, please treat the details with the same steady care and keep any escalation calm and practical.

Thanks for keeping the service warm and the process consistent. Small, careful updates from each of us make a big difference for pets and their people.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
